card1993nber.note: NBER WP 4483, October 1993 (title page and abstract page). 37-page scan without a text layer: OCR'd with tesseract at 300 dpi; every number in sources/notes.md from Tables 1-5 (PDF pp. 33-37) was read from the page images, not from OCR. guggenberger2012asymptotic.note: Abstract page read (full text behind login). Abstract: under homoskedasticity the subset AR test that plugs in LIML for the untested parameters has correct asymptotic size without extra identification assumptions; the subset LM test is size-distorted. The chi-square(k - m_W) critical value is stated by GKM19 (guggenberger2019more, p. 488) and Andrews-Stock-Sun (manuscript p. 31), both fetched. A related earlier paper, Chen and Guggenberger (Nov 2011, albany.edu), was downloaded but is not this article.

(2.5)-(2.8) (p. 490-491), (2.13)-(2.16), Corollary 4, Algorithm 1 (p. 505-506), Table 3 for k - m_W = 1 (journal p. 519, read from the page image).
